description: This Java class defines a custom Liquibase changeset to identify and resolve duplicate EncounterRole names in the OpenMRS database. It queries the encounter_role table for duplicate names, appends suffixes to make them unique, and updates the database accordingly.

classes.name: DuplicateEncounterRoleNameChangeSet
classes.description: A class implementing Liquibase CustomTaskChange to update duplicate EncounterRole names.
